{{MissingInfo|1|enva}} [[File:Shonosuke.png|thumb|250px|Shonosuke]] '''Shonosuke''' (Japanese: '''ショーノスケ親方''' ''Master Shonosuke'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP194|Ring Masters]]''. He is the host of the annual [[Sumo Conference]]. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} first met him after walking through [[Rikishii Town]] and noticing [[Raiden]] and his {{p|Feraligatr}} training at a local facility. His knowledge and passion for the sport inspired Ash to compete. He watched over the entire tournament, and used his high-ranking position to protest the referee's ruling that "[[Jessie|Jessiyaki]]" and her {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}}, disguised as a {{p|Miltank}}, won against an {{p|Ursaring}}. {{TRT}}'s cover was blown after Shonosuke disqualified them for using the move {{m|Counter}}. After their defeat, the tournament continued on, and he later presented Ash with the Sumo Conference title and winning prizes. ==Trivia== * Shonosuke's name comes from the famous Japanese sumo wrestler Shonosuke Kimura. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{unknown color}}|bordercolor={{unknown color light}} |ja=富田耕生 ''Kōsei Tomita'' |es_eu=Javier Franquelo |ar=حسن حمدان ''Hasan Hamdan'' |he=דודיק סמדר ''Dudik Smadar'' |it=Salvatore Landolina |pt_br=Eleu Salvador |pl=Grzegorz Pawlak}}
